help.decisions.main: Core decision parameters: PP cost (number or variable), timings and sort priority.
help.decisions.picture: Category banner in the decisions panel (GFX_decision_cat_picture_* sprites). Optional.
help.decisions.mission: Mission parameters: the days_mission_timeout timer, timeout behaviour and restarts.
help.decisions.war: Shows the player a "will lead to war with X" warning on the decision button.
help.script.allowed: Static check, evaluated once at game start. Decides whether a country can ever see this decision (usually original_tag).
help.script.visible: Trigger: the decision is listed while this holds. Checked frequently — keep it cheap.
help.script.available: Trigger: activation conditions. The decision is visible but greyed out while false.
help.decisions.visible_when_empty: Keep the category's tab shown even when it has no currently-visible decisions.
help.script.activation: Trigger: when true, the mission activates automatically.
help.script.target_trigger: Trigger for targeted decisions: checked per candidate country from targets; FROM is the potential target.
help.script.target_root_trigger: Trigger on ROOT: a fast pre-check before iterating targets.
help.script.cancel_trigger: Trigger: an active decision/mission is cancelled (no remove_effect) when this becomes true.
help.script.remove_trigger: Trigger: an active decision finishes early, firing remove_effect, when this becomes true.
help.script.custom_cost_trigger: Custom cost condition: the decision stays selectable while true (e.g. having a resource). Pairs with custom_cost_text.
help.script.custom_cost_text: Localisation key of the cost text shown instead of PP (for custom_cost_trigger).
help.script.complete_effect: Effects fired on clicking the decision (before days_remove elapses).
help.script.remove_effect: Effects fired on completion: after days_remove or via remove_trigger.
help.script.timeout_effect: Effects fired when the mission timer (days_mission_timeout) runs out.
help.script.cancel_effect: Effects fired on cancellation via cancel_trigger.
help.script.modifier: Modifiers applied to the country while the decision is active (between complete and remove).
help.script.targeted_modifier: Modifiers applied towards a specific target (tag = ... inside the block).
help.script.ai_will_do: AI weight: base/factor plus conditional modifiers. 0 — the AI never takes it.
help.script.targets: Targets of a targeted decision: country tags, scopes or variable arrays.
help.script.highlight_states: States highlighted on the map while the decision is selected.
help.script.on_map_mode: Where the decision is shown: map_only, decision_view_only, or map_and_decisions_view.
help.script.fire_only_once: The decision can be taken only once per game.
help.script.is_good: For missions: yes — the timer is "good" (green), no — a threat (red).
help.script.selectable_mission: The mission must be activated manually with a button (otherwise the activation trigger starts it).
help.script.cancel_if_not_visible: An active decision is cancelled once it stops being visible.
help.script.targets_dynamic: Targets come from a dynamic variable array (targets = { array }).
help.script.state_target: Makes a decision target a specific map state rather than a country.
help.script.fixed_random_seed: no — random effects in timeout_effect reroll on every timeout (the seed is fixed by default).
help.script.days_mission_timeout: Mission timer in days; timeout_effect fires when it expires.
help.script.ai_hint_pp_cost: AI hint: how much PP to reserve for this decision.
help.script.war_with_on_remove: "Will lead to war with tag" warning on decision completion.
help.script.war_with_on_complete: "Will lead to war with tag" warning on clicking the decision.
help.script.war_with_on_timeout: "Will lead to war with tag" warning on timer expiry.
help.script.cost: Political power cost: a number or a variable (var:xxx).
help.script.days_remove: How many days the decision "executes" after clicking; then remove_effect fires.
help.script.days_re_enable: Days after completion before the decision can be taken again.
help.script.priority: Sort order within the category (higher — earlier).
help.script.bypass: Trigger: the focus is auto-completed at no time cost when this holds.
help.script.cancel: Trigger: an in-progress focus is cancelled when this holds.
help.script.allow_branch: Trigger: the whole focus branch is hidden while false. Checked on load/tree switch.
help.script.select_effect: Effects fired the moment the focus starts (before completion).
help.script.completion_reward: Reward effects fired on focus completion.
help.script.complete_tooltip: Tooltip override: shown instead of the auto-generated completion_reward description.

help.map.delete_state: "Deletes" the state: its provinces are released and the state becomes an empty placeholder — a free index (red in the list). The file is kept on purpose: HOI4 crashes when state ids are not contiguous, so the id waits to be reused by the next created/generated state. Works on vanilla states too (writes a mod override).

help.map.make_replace: One-time switch of the mod to a FULL state replacement: every remaining base-game state file is copied into the mod, and replace_path="history/states" is written into both descriptors (descriptor.mod inside the mod + the launcher-side .mod). After that vanilla state files no longer load, and deleting a state removes its file for real. IRREVERSIBLE from within ANKA.
map.confirm_make_replace:
Switch the mod to replace_path="history/states"?

• {count} base-game state file(s) will be copied into the mod
• replace_path will be written into BOTH descriptors (descriptor.mod and the launcher .mod)
• vanilla states will no longer load — the mod becomes the only source of states
• deleting states will remove files for real
• undo history will be cleared

THIS CANNOT BE UNDONE from ANKA. Continue?

help.map.mode: Map coloring mode (hotkeys F1–F4): raw province colors, terrain categories, owner-country colors, or deterministic state colors.
help.map.tools: Tools (hotkeys 1–5): ⭘ select province · ⭘⭘ select state (click or rubber-band picks whole states) · 🖌 brush (paints the active province) · 🪣 flood fill · 💉 picker (grab the province under the cursor as the brush). Shift-click / Shift-drag add to a multi-selection. 'Select only ground' skips sea & lake. Editing province borders stales positions.txt — regenerate with Nudge.
help.map.split: Splits a province into K connected parts with natural borders (cluster-growth algorithm). New provinces inherit the source's type/terrain/continent and strategic region; coastal is auto-detected from sea adjacency.
help.map.gen_states_help: Clusters the selected land provinces into N new states (with preview). Manpower, industry and resources are split proportionally and victory points move to the state that gets their province.
map.multi_selected: Selected provinces: {count} · {area} px (Shift+click / Shift+drag, Esc clears)
map.err.no_selection: Select a province or several (Shift+click / Shift+drag).
editors.on_actions.name: On Actions
editors.on_actions.desc: Engine hooks (common/on_actions): effects fired on game events — startup, capitulation, government change, etc.
on_actions.select_hint: Pick an on_action in the list on the left or create one (➕).
on_actions.pick_tag: Pick a country for this hook
on_actions.confirm_delete: Delete entry {name} from the mod file?
on_actions.issue.empty_entry: Empty entry — neither effect nor random_events
on_actions.issue.unknown_name: Unknown hook name (not in vanilla on_actions and not a TAG variant)
help.on_actions.effect: Effects executed when the hook fires. Multiple vanilla effect blocks are merged into one by the editor — equivalent for the engine.
editors.interface.name: Interface
editors.interface.desc: GUI editor: .gfx sprites, .gui windows with a live WYSIWYG canvas, scripted GUIs.
interface.gfx.select_hint: Select a sprite from the list
interface.gfx.resize.bad_size: Enter a valid width and height (positive numbers).
interface.gfx.resize.missing: Texture file not found — import a file first.
interface.gfx.resize.confirm: This action cannot be undone! You are about to resize the image to {size}.
interface.palette.title: Widget palette
interface.gui.select_hint: Select a window or an element — or create a new one from the palette
interface.gui.confirm_delete_window: Delete window "{name}" with everything inside it?
interface.gui.new_window_hint: Open a mod .gui file first (or create one).
interface.gui.issue.dup_name: Duplicate element name in this window
interface.sgui.select_hint: Select a scripted GUI from the list
interface.sgui.pick_element: Pick an element of the window
interface.sgui.pick_gridbox: Pick a gridbox of the window
interface.sgui.issue.element_not_found: Element not found in the window: {detail}
dyn_mod.select_hint: Select a dynamic modifier from the list
map.reassign_confirm: Change state id {old} → {new}? The file will be renamed, STATE_{old} localisation and map-folder references will be migrated. This cannot be undone (Ctrl+Z history is cleared).
editors.scripted_loc.name: Scripted localisation
editors.scripted_loc.desc: Dynamic localisation keys (common/scripted_localisation): defined_text entries and the loc values they reference.
scripted_loc.select_hint: Select a scripted localisation on the left, or create a new one.
scripted_loc.no_loc_keys: This entry references no localization_key yet.
scripted_loc.one_defined_text: The script must contain exactly one defined_text = { … } block.
scripted_loc.confirm_delete_file: Delete file "{name}" and all its scripted localisations?
interface.loc.sl_hint: Insert a scripted localisation ([name]) into the text
interface.loc.no_scripted_loc: No scripted localisations found. Create some in the Scripted localisation editor.
scripted_loc.field.name: Name
equipment.confirm_delete: Delete equipment {name}? References to it will be removed.
equipment.warn.tech_refs: {count} technologies still reference "{id}" in enable_equipments — update them on the tech tree tab.
equipment.loc.name: Name
help.technologies.folders: Technology folders — the tabs of the research screen (common/technology_tags). Each folder groups technologies and has a ledger (army/navy/air/civilian) plus its own .gui layout. Red = the folder has no working GUI.
help.technologies.tags: Technology categories and folders (common/technology_tags). Categories are the labels techs are tagged with — modifiers, AI research and doctrines target them; folders are the research-screen tabs.
help.technologies.add_tech: Add a new technology to the open folder. It is written to your mod's technology file; vanilla files stay read-only until copied into the mod.
help.technologies.doctrines: Doctrine trees (the new doctrine system): mutually exclusive doctrine paths and their unlocks.
help.technologies.inspector: Properties of the selected technology (or the open folder): cost, year, folder position, links, unlocks, modifiers, localisation and icon.
help.technologies.new_folder: Create a custom research tab: writes the technology_tags declaration, clones a .gui skeleton from a template folder, registers the tab sprite and the localisation.
